component.name: OCTA-CAPTURE ALSA driver
component.summary: Standalone audio and MIDI driver for Roland OCTA-CAPTURE

description.p: Standalone ALSA USB audio and MIDI module for the Roland OCTA-CAPTURE UA-1010. A private Linux 6.12 ALSA source snapshot builds with DKMS against matching kernel headers, without rebuilding or patching the kernel.
Base and VS EXPAND USB personalities are recognized. Physical EXP operation and synchronized two-unit streaming remain experimental and unverified.
